{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the punishment| the exiled [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles|survivors]] of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], or [[Meetra Surik]], a female [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] known as the Jedi Exile, or [[Exile (disambiguation)|other uses of the term]]}}
[[File:Force_Sensitive_Exile_EotECR.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Unidentified Twi'lek Force-sensitive|Twi'lek]] survivor of Order 66, who went into exile to escape the Empire]]
{{Quote|I had thought you had taken the exile's path, wandering the galaxy.|[[Atris]] to [[Meetra Surik]]|<ref name="KOTOR 2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Exile''' was a form of punishment used by numerous cultures and sentient species across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in which the punished were banished from the society issuing the punishment, rarely ever to return. This form of punishment was known to be practiced by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] against members who went against the will of the Order or turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Not all cases of exile were a form of punishment, as any being could place themselves in a self-imposed exile for a wrong they perceived they had done, removing themselves from society to keep them from wronging another again, or for failing a task they had believed they should have accomplished.

==Examples of exile==
{{Quote|Into exile I must go. Failed I have.|Yoda, after being unable to defeat Darth Sidious|<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
*The [[Exiles]] were the last<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> twelve<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> leaders of a group of Jedi who had turned to the dark side and initiated the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]], and were banished from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic space]] after the [[Battle of Corbos]]. Their exile would see them discovering the planet of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], setting in motion the creation of the [[Sith Order]].<ref name="JvS" />
*[[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], once [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], was exiled by his short-lived successor [[Ludo Kressh]] after [[First battle of Korriban|encountering]] his rival's [[Ludo Kressh's faction|forces]] in orbit around [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Sadow eventually chose the destination of his exile as [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]].<ref name="TofJ:TFotSE5:EoaE">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]]</ref>
*During his reign as [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], [[Freedon Nadd]] exiled anyone who opposed his rule.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*[[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] went into self-imposed exile on [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] after being stripped of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="TotJ:R1:AGoJ">[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 1]]</ref>
*[[Jolee Bindo]] chose to exile himself from the Jedi Order when he felt they failed him by forgiving him for his self-appointed training of his wife, [[Nayama]] Bindo, who fell to the dark side during [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] war against the Jedi. He believed that he deserved punishment instead of the promotion to Jedi Knight that the order gave him.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
*[[Meetra Surik]] was exiled from the Jedi Order after her involvement in the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and returning changed, a change that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] of that time feared.<ref name="KOTOR 2" />
*[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kreia]] was exiled from the Jedi Order for her training of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his fall to the dark side. She would later be exiled from the [[Sith Triumvirate]] and stripped of her power by her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]], [[Darth Sion]] and [[Darth Nihilus]].<ref name="KOTOR 2" />
*[[Canderous Ordo]] went into self-imposed exile after the end of the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>
*[[Tasiele Shan]] was exiled to an [[Unidentified Outer Rim planet (Tasiele Shan)|unidentified planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] by the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order for challenging the Order's views on attachment and [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] like her [[Shan family|ancestors]] did before her.<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*[[Allya/Legends|Allya]], a female Jedi, was exiled to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]] by the Jedi Order.<ref name="NEC" />
*[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] was forced into exile on the surface of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after being banished from [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].<ref name="The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref>

[[File:The_Wanderer_CotG.png|thumb|right|180px|Suljo Warde in self-imposed exile on Moraband]]
*[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] went into a self-imposed exile on [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]] after his defeat during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>
*[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] went into exile after the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle of Dathomir]] when the Nightsister clan was destroyed by [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]]. It was very brief after she became a bounty hunter.<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref>
*[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] was exiled for his preemptive military actions by [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], to an unnamed planet, where he was later discovered by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]].<ref name="Mist Encounter">
{{JournalCite|7|Mist Encounter}}</ref>
*[[Suljo Warde]] went into self-imposed exile on the Sith tombworld of [[Korriban/Legends|Moraband]] after falling to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of the Force.<ref name="CotG">''[[Chronicles of the Gatekeeper]]''</ref>
*[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] went into self-imposed exile on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] after failing to defeat [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] after the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*[[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] went into a self-imposed exile on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>
*[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went into exile on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after failing to stop [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="ROTS" />
*Many survivors of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] went into exile far from the reach of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EotECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]&mdash;"Force Sensitive Exile"</ref>
*After crashing his personal [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-Wing]] on the planet [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]], [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] exiled himself on his [[Ackbar's seapod|seapod]] on [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="Dark Apprentice">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>
*[[Ithila]], a [[Hapan]] woman, went into self-imposed exile after being scarred horribly during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], ruining her beauty as she was allergic to [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]].<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>
*As per the [[Sekot accords|peace agreement]] which ended their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] with [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species were self-exiled to the living world of [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]].<ref name="Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>
*[[Tahiri Veila]], [[Lowbacca]] and [[Tesar Sebatyne]] were placed in temporary exile on Dagobah after choosing to spy on the [[New Jedi Order]] for the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] in [[36 ABY]].<ref name="The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was exiled by [[Natasi Daala]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and any planet which had a [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] or other similar Jedi facility on it in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]].<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>
